name: Vz-HextrudORT Low
description: The Vz Hextrudort Low is a CNC-machined aluminum extruder designed by the VzBoT community for lightweight direct drive setups. It is the standard CNC variant of the Vz-HextrudORT, smaller in the Y direction than the printed version, and compatible with 8T or 10T NEMA14 round stepper motors. Designed for high-speed printers such as the VzBoT.

motorSpecs.compatibleMotors: NEMA14 round (8T or 10T pinion, e.g. LDO-36STH20-1004, Moons equivalent)

features: Lightweight design for reduced toolhead inertia
Smaller Y-axis profile than printed version
Compatible with 8T or 10T NEMA14 round motors
Community design adapted from MirageC HextrudORT
